{{Top}}
'''Sic-Six-layer cake''' was a type of cake made by the arachnoid [[Sic-Six/Legends|Sic-Six]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sisk/Legends|Sisk]]. The cake had six layers ranging in color from infrared to ultraviolet. It was served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where it cost 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|At its most basic level, this thinking led to a number of puns--Panna cakes, Wol Cabasshews, Xizor salad, Sic-Six-layer cake, Tibanna split and Shili cheese dog among them&mdash;that are either inspired or stupid or both, depending on one's sense of humor.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
The dish is a reference to the real-life [[Wikipedia:Layer cake|Layer cake]] as well as a pun.
